His specialty is how economic crises reshape alliances and international cooperation.

<action type="say">
I tried to block your Travel Card and request a replacement, but the card service is currently returning an internal error, and the card has NOT been blocked yet through this channel.

Because the card is reported stolen, you should immediately do one of the following so it gets blocked right away:

1. Call customer support (fastest option)  
   - Use the number on the back of your card (if you still have a photo of it) or on your bank’s website/mobile app “Contact Us” section.  
   - When you call, say you need to report a STOLEN credit card and have it blocked immediately and reissued.

2. Use your bank’s mobile app or website (if available)  
   - Go to your credit card account → look for “Lock card,” “Report stolen,” or “Freeze card.”  
   - Complete the stolen card flow there so the card is blocked and a replacement is ordered.

3. Visit a branch (if you can)  
   - Tell them your Travel Card ending in 7890 is stolen and must be blocked and replaced right away.

Until it’s confirmed blocked, do not use this card anywhere, and monitor your recent transactions for anything you don’t recognize. If you’d like, once you’ve contacted the bank and had it blocked, I can help you review recent transactions and start disputes for any unauthorized charges.</action>
